name: Scanned PDF Tables → Excel
description: Drop any PDF — text OR scanned — and get an Excel workbook of its tables, one sheet per page, entirely on your device. Text pages are read exactly from the PDF's own text. Scanned (image-only) pages go through real OCR on your GPU: PP-OCR text detection and recognition plus SLANet table-structure analysis, running on ONNX Runtime over WebGPU and falling back to the CPU where there is no GPU. Built for SERFF insurance rate/rule filings, which mix born-digital rate tables with scanned exhibits. Every model is packed inside this GIF; there is no network access at all, so the filing and the spreadsheet never leave this device. Its smaller sibling, PDF Tables → Excel, stays the tiny text-only option.
